item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh northeast monsoon will bring cooler weather in the morning and at night to Guangdong in the next couple of days. An intense replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will fall further and it will be very dry over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Dry with sunny periods during the day. Cooler in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 55 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
